name: bg3-data-mcp bridge
author: bg3-data-mcp
description: Lets the bg3-data MCP server (and only it, via a local token) ask Vortex for status, deploy, purge, enable/disable/remove mods, list/create/switch profiles, and check Nexus for updates / download / install them through Vortex's own Nexus login. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
